entries.displayName: Evidence on brand, AI search and agents (English)
entries.description: Checked figures on brand, AI search, AI agents, agentic commerce and liability, each with its primary source, date, grade and an explicit statement of what it does not prove. Generated from the page https://robert-haase.de/en/evidence.html. The JSON holds all entries and is too large for a single fetch; the Markdown overview https://robert-haase.de/en/evidence.md lists every claim on one line and links one file per topic, each small enough for a single fetch.

does llms.txt or structured data improve visibility in AI answers
is a company liable for what its customer service chatbot tells customers
how large will agentic commerce be by 2030
verified statistics on brands and AI agents with primary sources
